steps.text: Acids and bases have opposite properties. Let's identify substances by tapping them in the game below.
Tap “Lemon” — an acid. Notice it's sour and turns blue litmus red.
Now tap “Soap” — a base. It feels slippery and turns red litmus blue.
Tap “Water” — it's neutral, so litmus doesn't change at all.
Compare the results in the table: acids are sour and turn litmus red; bases feel soapy and turn litmus blue. Never taste substances to test them — always use an indicator!
